test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six poles, A, B, C, D, E and F, are located in the same colony. B is 20 m to the west of C. F is 60 m to the south of E. C is 30 m to the north of E. A is 60 m to the west of B. D is 30 m to the south of B. In which direction is A with reference to C?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) B is 20 m to the west of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34f212e1a12de6bf02960c1690c1adb75eb123cb45241a3465a97cc94c2becd7.png] 

2) C is 30 m to the north of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e06692562dfd466a37c632d8382458c2bc93871630975d18cfec120b4d364c5.png] 

3) F is 60 m to the south of E.
